premises.text: Combustion power plants are inefficient, inflexible, and emit large amounts of CO2
premises.evidence_span: They are highly inefficient, they are not flexible, and they emit millions of tons of CO2

premises.text: A closed-cycle SOFC system with CO2 separation and methanation reaches ~80% electric efficiency, full fuel conversion, pure CO2 output, and reversible power-to-gas
premises.evidence_span: produces power at a groundbreaking efficiency of 80%. It is fully reversible. It is plug and play, and it even has a carbon negative footprint

premises.text: Biogas plants are the first market, earning more from doubled electric efficiency and reversible operation
premises.evidence_span: Biogas plants are our first target market

value.text: Decentralized, carbon-negative, highly efficient power generation
value.evidence_span: decentralized, carbon negative, and highly efficient power plants

secondary_value.text: Fivefold income uplift for biogas customers from efficiency and reversible operation
secondary_value.evidence_span: they can overall more than fivefold their income

causal_links.evidence_span: we achieve 100% fuel conversion and 80% electric efficiency
when there is not enough solar or wind power in the power grid, we produce renewable power from the biogas while separating pure CO2

notes: SOFC + CO2 separation + methanation + efficiency/reversibility/carbon-negative metrics folded as one process+performance package (v1.5.1 §4.1.8). Container tour subsystems treated as implementation detail of P2. Global replacement vision and market-size figures excluded.
